capture_limitations: This is a concise review record, not a raw HTML/PDF capture. content_hash hashes these exact review-record bytes. Running source_sync sync will store raw response bytes and replace this baseline hash only for sections it can verify.
source_recommendation_assessment: OWASP’s logging guidance cautions against recording passwords, access tokens, connection strings, encryption keys, and sensitive personal data. The control asks logs to retain security-relevant context while excluding those values.
source_version_or_section: Data to exclude or mask: passwords, tokens, connection strings, and sensitive data
